verdict.rationale: ROS 2 can record robot data to bags with `ros2 bag` and offers a Python API for reading bags from your own code, so developers can programmatically get at collected data for offline analysis. Community users confirm data bagging as a core benefit. Missing for 10: SQL query interface, query/filter semantics (by time, topic or field), export to analysis formats (e.g. CSV/Parquet), and in-depth docs on the bag reader API.
